english.title: Fail to deliver expenses return in accordance with section 81
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that, being the election agent of a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you failed to deliver to the appropriate officer, within

(A)_[35]_
(B)_[70]_

days after the day on which

(C)_[the result of the election was declared,]_
(D)_[the last of the successful candidates at the election was declared to be returned,]_

a true return containing as respects that candidate a statement of all election expenses incurred by or on behalf of the candidate and a statement of all payments made by the election agent together with all bills or receipts relating to the payments, in accordance with section 81 of the Representation of the People Act 1983 in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 81, 84 and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

english.notes:
(i) Option B is in relation to the election of the Mayor of London, as per section 81(1A)(a) of the Act.
(ii) Option D is in relation to the election of the London members of the London Assembly at an ordinary election, as per section 81(1A)(b) of the Act.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale. Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
